reviewer: root agent, actual PNGs viewed with view_image
scope: Native Godot island-water preview only. No performance acceptance or full game migration claim.

findings.effect: source island shape and terrain palette
findings.observed: Same elongated Cat Island coastline and peaks; sand, green land and rocky high terrain present.
Blue-green sea with gradual bright shallow zone visible around actual terrain.
Low angle reveals displaced wave surface; time and wave toggle change actual pixels.
Low angle reflection-on and reflection-off show corresponding image differences; metadata confirms shared World3D and water-layer exclusion.
Thin white coastline and shallow caustic network present; disabling each changes its corresponding layer.
High tide hides low terrain and shortens coastline; low tide reveals wider sand.
Same native camera and accepted time clear/paused images are pixel-identical.
Clear, sunset and storm render; resized controls remain available; native save writes real PNG.
No blank texture rectangle, recursive mirror feedback, upside-down reflection or missing terrain patch seen in inspected images.

sourceComparison.method: Opened actual browser demo, disabled waves/foam/caustics with reflection on and default orbit; viewed browser screenshot against native static-source-state at 1359x960.
sourceComparison.result: Qualitatively similar source shape, palette, shoreline and shallow-water gradient.
sourceComparison.notPerformed: Automated WebGL/Godot pixel-error comparison. Original page PNG download timed out; no original downloaded PNG is claimed.

boundaries: Native controls are exercised through actual Godot control signals/properties and scene methods; this is not an OS mouse/keyboard replay.
No source RGBA8 per-texel 8-bit quantization emulation or pixel-perfect parity claim.
Native focus pause, discrete wheel input and viewport sizing are host adaptations.

The final layer-boundary repair changes only ownership of identical Float32 wave uniforms; no shader, mesh, reflection or color formula changes. Current exported build receives its own native smoke capture.
